page.layout: One page of running text, one column. Chapter number and title centred at the top. Catchword at the lower right. Show-through from the reverse side in the left margin is not transcribed.

main_text.head: XV. DE STATV EPIRI.
main_text.p: PIRVS quondam etiam sub regibus suis non vili parte libertatis gavisa fuit. Nam ut prodit Plutarchus in Pyrrho, rex & populus quotannis solenni in conventu in regione Moloffidis mutuo juramento obstringere se solebant, ille secundum leges se regnaturum, hic regnum se ei confervaturos regnanti se-cundum leges. Eadem verò Epirus à Pyrrhi abnepte Deïdamiâ, cum ipsa ca-reret liberis, integrâ & plenâ libertate donata suam quoque rempublicam pe-culiarem habuit per tempora illa eadem: sed quæ forma ejus fuerit, hactenus me latet. Hoc tantum apud Poly-bium reperio, tres eodem tempore prae-tores eam habuisse, qui rempublicam regerent: an plures etiam fuerint, non constat[?]. Retinuit autem Epirus qua-cunque libertatem à Macedonibus concussam ad casum usque Achæo-rum[?]. Quo tempore ipsa quoque provinciæ Achaiæ attributa est.

page.notes: The decorative initial P at the start of the text is joined to the first word. The word "constat" is partly hidden by the overlap at the line end, so the first letters are doubtful. The last line of the page before the catchword is partly hidden by show-through, so "Achæo-rum" is doubtful. Several line-end hyphens ("ca-reret", "se-cundum", "prae-tores", "pe-culiarem", "qua-cunque") were read from the broken words. Spaced capitals in the title ("E P I R I") were set as one word. Mirrored show-through in the left margin was not transcribed.
